newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Dec 26.

text.p: Canon Inc is expected to pay a 15 yen dividend per share in the year to December 1996 after likely increasing its pre-tax profit by 50 percent to more than 120 billion yen.

Idemitsu Petrochemical Co Ltd plans to cut imports of naphtha, a raw material for petrochemical products, by nearly 10 percent from January. It will also reduce production of propyl, a material used to make synthetic resins and fibres.

Three of Japan's four leading drug wholesalers are expected to see lower pre-tax profits in the business year to March 1997. Kuraya Corp and Sanseido Co Ltd are seen posting flat pre-tax profits. Nippon Shoji Kaisha Ltd is likely to see profits fall by eight percent.
Suzuken Co Ltd is expected to see its pre-tax profits increase by four percent.
